notice.title: Credit card minimum payment warnings
notice.aiSummary: Card issuers must display on each monthly statement the time needed to repay the balance by making only minimum payments and the total interest cost. Compliance is required by May 1, 2027.
notice.aiReason: The notice applies to card issuers that offer revolving credit cards to consumers, and Brivanta Bank offers credit cards to its customers.

text:
RETAIL CONDUCT AUTHORITY FICTIONAL REGULATOR - SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE
Final rule: Credit card minimum payment warnings
Notice number: RCN-2026-013
Issued by: Retail Conduct Authority
Published: 2026-10-16
Effective date: 2027-05-01
1. Who this applies to
Card issuers that offer revolving credit cards to consumers.
2. Background
Customers who pay only the minimum each month can stay in debt for many years. A clear warning helps them see the cost.
3. Requirements
3.1 A card issuer must show on each monthly statement how long it would take to repay the balance by paying only the minimum, and the total interest that would be paid.
4. Status
Firms must comply with the requirements in section 3 from 2027-05-01.

obligations.text: A card issuer must show on each monthly statement how long it would take to repay the balance by paying only the minimum, and the total interest that would be paid.
obligations.controlDesc: Statement template review confirms the minimum-payment warning, time to repay and total interest
obligations.reason: Policy POL-CRD-01 requires monthly card statements to show "a minimum-payment warning with the time to repay and total interest if only the minimum is paid," which exactly matches the obligation's requirements, and Control CTL-191 confirms the presence of these elements.
